Canvas fits 4 per box. Paper print fits 6 per box.

1 canvas in box -> box is 25% filled
1 paper print is 1/6 of box -> ~17% filled

(1/4) + (1/6)*5 = 1.08 -> over box limit

(1/4) + (1/6)*4 = 0.92 -> under box limit

1 canvas and 4 paper prints fit in one large box, leaving 1 paper print left. Add this to one large box -> 2 large boxes
